As part of the ASP service within the IT department, client is looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure reliable, compliant, and optimized management of the IT software license portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring activities, with a strong focus on coordination between IT, Procurement, and Finance teams. The consultant will contribute to cost control, license compliance, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes.
Key responsibilities

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT licenses: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and renewal

• Maintain an accurate, reliable, and up-to-date database of active, expired, renewable, and licenses to be retired

• Propose optimization actions to reduce costs and improve license utilization

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making

• Provide administrative and analytical follow-up for Software Asset Management activities

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has solid experience in Software Asset Management or IT Asset Management, combined with strong administrative, analytical, and license-management skills.

They are able to work independently, analyze complex data, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.

Mandatory skills

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a role related to:

• Software Asset Management

• IT License Management

• IT Asset Management

• IT Procurement

• or a similar function

• Good knowledge of software licensing models from major software vendors

• Experience analyzing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms

• Strong ability to analyze software usage data

• Good knowledge of at least one analytical tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI

• Ability to prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards

• French or Dutch with fluent English

• Strong administrative rigor and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently

• Autonomous, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset

 

Strong assets

• Experience with SAM/ITAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI

• Experience with software cost optimization and renewal management

• Experience working in a complex IT or large-enterprise environment

• Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

Professional & soft skills

• Excellent analytical skills

• Autonomous and responsible

• Strong ownership and accountability

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills

• Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams

• Results-oriented and focused on continuous improvement

• Critical thinking and solution-oriented approach

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.Concretely you will:

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Business Consultant Manufacturing & Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

 
• As part of the development of the Industry sector team with a focus on manufacturing & supply chain, we are looking to strengthen the team.
 
• You will participate in on both client activities as internal activities supporting the growth of our Industry sector team within Inetum Consulting:
  
   
• We are interested in people with proven track records in delivering mid-large scale digital projects linked to manufacturing & supply chain topics.
   
• We believe in people we hire, we encourage people to take ownership by given them the right support, environment and tools to be successful at Inetum.
  
 
• You will execute & leading project assignments, including, data analysis, benchmarks, interviews, workshop animation, process mapping, business analysis, implementation roadmaps etc.
 
• Following the assignment, you will take up team lead roles.
 
• You will get the opportunity to contribute actively within the Industry Sector team to support the growth, expand our offering in manufacturing and supply chain and participate to seminars, publications,....
 
• Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to collaborate within the Inetum Consulting global business line:
  
   
• Carrying out projects to improve operational performance
   
• Assisting the project owner or Program Manager on major digital transformation programmes
   
• Strategic framing and optimisation...
  
...

• You have at least 3 years of experience in the manufacturing or supply chain industry gained within a consulting firm focused on Operations Excellence.

• You have actively participated in cross-functional projects to improve operational excellence.

• Your experience, skills, and communication abilities allow you to manage project teams at our key clients.

• Your ability to propose solutions enables you to assert yourself on high-value-added business topics with Industrial and General Management.

• An interest in ERP tools, MES solutions and Industry 4.0 technologies is a differentiating plus.

• You are fluent in Dutch or French and English and proficient in Dutch or French at least professionally, allowing you to conduct workshops in an international environment.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.
